title: Stand-In Effects and Pooling Amplification: Lessons from Biological World Models for Testing Action Effects
abstract: arXiv:2611.01666v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly trained on data from randomized experiments, and whether their predictions respond to actions is usually checked by replacing or removing the actions and measuring the loss in accuracy. Taking biological experiments as the guiding case, we show that such diagnostics report action effects where there are none: under autocorrelated designs, future actions stand in for history the model does not see. When the design law is known, a conditional randomization test written as an e-value is valid in finite samples whatever the model, provided the resampler conditions on the full state the design used. A second failure arises whenever many sites share one action sequence, as in world models: the pooled score turns small model errors along the action contrast into overwhelming evidence against a true effect. In a pixel world, its median log e-value fell from -17.3 to -6832 as frames grew from 6

translated_title: 替身效应与池化放大：来自生物学世界模型的动作效应检验启示
translated_abstract: 动作条件化的世界模型越来越多地使用随机化实验的数据进行训练，而其预测是否响应动作通常通过替换或移除动作并测量精度损失来检验。以生物学实验为指导案例，我们证明这类诊断会在不存在动作效应之处报告出动作效应：在自相关设计下，未来的动作会充当模型无法看到的历史的“替身”。当设计规律已知时，以e值形式写出的条件随机化检验在有限样本下对任何模型都有效，前提是重采样器以设计所使用的完整状态为条件。第二类失败出现在许多位点共享同一动作序列的情形（正如世界模型中那样）：池化得分会将沿动作对比方向的微小模型误差转化为反对真实效应的压倒性证据。在一个像素世界中，随着帧数从6（增加），其中位数log e值从-17.3降至-6832。
tldr: 该论文揭示了检验世界模型动作效应的常用诊断存在两类系统性失败——自相关设计下未来动作“替身”未见历史导致虚假效应、多数据源池化将微小模型误差放大为反对真实效应的压倒性假证据——并提出以设计所用完整状态为条件的e值条件随机化检验，实现有限样本下有效的动作效应检验。
en_tdlr: Common diagnostics for testing whether world model predictions respond to actions are shown to produce spurious action effects (future actions stand in for unseen history under autocorrelated designs) and to amplify small model errors into overwhelming false evidence when data are pooled across sites, motivating a finite-sample-valid conditional randomization test written as an e-value that conditions on the full state used by the experimental design.
